subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw core support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery, or keep agent registration explicit and prioritize zero-restart explicit agent management?
rationale: Source inspection proves the feature is missing, but the requested fix chooses a new config surface and filesystem trust boundary that automation cannot select safely.

options.title: Keep explicit registration
options.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and solve the reported operational pain through hot explicit registration before adding glob discovery.

options.title: Design trusted discovery
options.body: Approve core discovery only after maintainers define trusted roots, glob bounds, realpath/symlink behavior, validation, precedence, reload semantics, and security proof.

options.title: Move discovery outside core
options.body: Keep workspace scanning as operator tooling or plugin/ClawHub work unless a smaller missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and solve the reported operational pain through hot explicit registration before adding glob discovery.
